WPScan Cheat Sheet
Certified Penetration Testing Professional
WPScan Cheat Sheet
WPScan
Source: https://github.com
WPScan is a powerful tool used by attackers to identify vulnerabilities in WordPress websites. It
automates the process of discovering security issues, outdated components, and potential entry
points that can be exploited.
Syntax
wpscan --url <URL> --enumerate p
Options
The URL of the blog to scan. Allowed Protocols: http, https. Default
--url URL Protocol if none provided: http. This option is mandatory unless update
or help or hh or version is/are supplied.
-h, --help Display the simple help and exit.
--hh Display the full help and exit.
--version Display the version and exit.
-v, --verbose Verbose mode.
--[no-]banner Whether or not to display the banner. Default: true.
-o, --output FILE Output to FILE.
-f, --format Output results in the format supplied. Available choices: cli-no-color,
FORMAT json, cli, cli-no-colour.
--detection-mode
Default: mixed. Available choices: mixed, passive, aggressive.
MODE
--user-agent, --ua
Specify a custom user-agent.
VALUE

Use a random user-agent for each scan.
agent, --rua

HTTP authentication credentials.
login:password
-t, --max-threads
The max threads to use. Default: 5.
VALUE
--throttle Milliseconds to wait before doing another web request. If used, the max
MilliSeconds threads will be set to 1.
--request-timeout
The request timeout in seconds. Default: 60.
SECONDS

The connection timeout in seconds. Default: 30.
SECONDS

protocol://IP:port

Proxy authentication credentials.
login:password

COOKIE cookie2=value2].

PATH

The WPScan API Token to display vulnerability data, available at
--api-token TOKEN
https://wpscan.com/profile.
--wp-content-dir The wp-content directory if custom or not detected, such as "wp-
DIR content".
--wp-plugins-dir The plugins directory if custom or not detected, such as "wp-
DIR content/plugins".
Enumeration Process. Available Choices: vp Vulnerable plugins, ap All
plugins, p Popular plugins, vt Vulnerable themes, at All themes, t Popular
themes, tt Timthumbs, cb Config backups, dbe Db exports, u User IDs
-e, --enumerate
range (e.g. u1-5), m Media IDs range (e.g. m1-15). Separator to use
[OPTS]
between the values: ','. Default: All Plugins, Config Backups. Value if no
argument supplied: vp, vt, tt, cb, dbe, u, m. Incompatible choices (only
one of each group/s can be used): - vp, ap, p - vt, at, t
--exclude-content- Exclude all responses matching the Regexp (case insensitive) during parts
based of the enumeration. Both the headers and body are checked. Regexp
REGEXP_OR_STRING delimiters are not required.
